O vilket mäktigt lov en gång
0:00 / —
SV EN FR AR

This is a translation of the Swedish lyrics and cannot be sung.

1.

O what mighty praise once Shall fill the many halls of heaven, |: When time is past! :| When all the redeemed, each and all, |: Take part in the wondrous song |: Of Jesus’ free love. :|:|

2.

Each one then like the Saviour is, Each one then a royal crown bears |: And white, spotless robe. :| An eternal song then rises up |: To Thee, God’s precious Lamb, to Thee, |: In the world of light with God. :|:|

3.

With Thee our joy no more is hindered, Thy glory we then clearly see |: And homage to Thee bring. :| The bright day we now await, |: When we from the heart shall sing: Thou, |: O Lord, art worthy! :|:|

Text: Efter What rich eternal bursts of praise av George W. Frazer, 1896. Musik: Come, comrades dear, anonym, 1880. 8.8.6.6.8.8.6.6.8.6
